name: Zifeng Huang
bio: Zifeng Huang received his bachelor's degree in engineering from the School of Energy and Power Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology. He joined the TherMAX-IC Lab in 2024 and is currently pursuing the Ph.D. degree at Peking University.
bioZh: 黄子丰本科毕业于华中科技大学能源与动力工程学院，获工学学士学位。2024年加入 TherMAX-IC 实验室，目前在北京大学攻读博士学位。
